title: Isolated atom reference energies
action: For each element (Li, Be, Sc, Cu, Al), compute the total energy of an isolated atom using a spin‑unpolarized DFT calculation in a 15×15×15 Å³ box with GGA‑PBE and the corresponding pslibrary 1.0.0 ultrasoft pseudopotential. Save the energies to a JSON file.
description: Obtain the reference energy εₐₜₒₘ for each element needed for cohesive energy calculations.

title: Geometry optimization of HX, bHC, bSQ structures
action: For each element, build unit cells for HX, bHC, bSQ. Use initial lattice constant = d₃ᴅ (Li:3.04, Be:2.22, Sc:3.26, Cu:2.56, Al:2.86 Å) and initial buckling for bHC/bSQ = 0.3×d₃ᴅ. Perform full DFT geometry optimization with GGA‑PBE, pslibrary 1.0.0 pseudopotentials, tight convergence (10⁻⁵ Ry energy, 10⁻⁴ a.u. forces), 30×30×1 k‑grid, wave‑function/charge cutoffs that are well converged (paper references: 80/800 Ry), Marzari‑Vanderbilt smearing σ=0.02 Ry, 14 Å vacuum. Record final a, δ, and total energy per atom εⱼ.
description: Obtain optimized geometries and total energies that are mandatory for cohesive energy and phonon calculations.

title: DFPT phonon calculations
action: For each relaxed HX, bHC, bSQ structure, run DFPT phonon calculations with the same QE setup. Use q‑point grids: 8×8×1 for HX and bHC; 6×6×1 for bSQ. Extract phonon frequencies; the key information is whether any imaginary modes appear.
description: Phonon dispersion data needed to judge dynamical stability.

title: Stability summary and results table
action: From the energies in Steps 1–2, compute cohesive energy per atom as Eⱼ = εₐₜₒₘ − εⱼ (eV). For each structure, examine the phonon results: if no imaginary frequencies exist, set stable=true; otherwise false. Collect all 15 entries into an array of objects and write to results_summary.json.
description: Final scored artifact containing all target quantities; its correctness depends on successful execution of all prior DFT/DFPT steps.
output_schema: Array of objects: { element: string, structure: "HX"|"bHC"|"bSQ", a: number (Å), delta: number (Å, 0 for HX), cohesive_energy_per_atom: number (eV), stable: bool }. All 15 combinations must be present.
